skills.description: Growth stock analysis applying Peter Lynch's framework. Classifies a stock into Lynch's six categories, decomposes revenue and profit growth into drivers, tests PEG for growth-versus-valuation matching, maps the industry penetration stage and remaining runway, then names three falsification signals. Activates for growth sustainability questions, emerging sector entry timing, ten-bagger hunting, and distinguishing real growth from narrative. Long-layer role of the A-share Sanniu series - answers how long a position can be held, never when to buy.
skills.description_zh: 彼得·林奇框架的成长性审判。先按林奇六分类（缓慢增长/稳定/快速增长/周期/困境反转/资产隐藏）给标的定性，再把营收增长拆成量、价、新品、并购四部分，用扣非增速剔除一次性收益，然后检验 PEG（含增速超 50% 时 PEG 失效的边界），判断赛道处于导入期、爆发期、成熟期还是衰退期。核心产出是"能拿多久"——渗透率早期可以按年拿，渗透率见顶只配做波段。最警惕两件事：用叙事冒充增长的假成长，和增长真实但已被价格透支的真成长。每次必给三条证伪信号：如果这个判断错了，最先出现的是什么。不构成投资建议。
skills.name: A股短线散牛——成长挖掘
